title: Email conversation adapter
lead: Read the conversation mailbox over IMAP and reply over SMTP (stdlib).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** Matrix; the receipts mailbox.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Email reaches everyone from anywhere with no new app.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: None if the notifications interview is done.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. IMAP poll of the conversation mailbox; mark handled messages; extract the new text.
2. SMTP reply through the notifier's email channel.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; the owner adds an item and asks "what's low" by email.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
